key_insight: Multifidelity Operator Inference supplements scarce high-fidelity training data with abundant coarse-grid data to reduce variance in learned reduced-order models.
engineering_relevance: Cheaper, more accurate PDE surrogates can support repeated simulations for uncertainty quantification and engineering design optimization without access to simulation source code.
method: Collect state snapshots and corresponding time derivatives for Operator Inference.
Combine scarce high-fidelity snapshots with abundant data from coarser discretizations of the same problem.
Estimate reduced operators using multifidelity linear regression.
evidence_signal: On model PDE problems, MF-OpInf predicts solution fields more accurately than high-fidelity-only OpInf under the same computational budget.
watch_item: The abstract reports model-PDE tests but does not establish performance on complex engineering systems or specify quantitative gains.
paper_title: Multifidelity Operator Inference for Non-intrusive Model Reduction under Data Scarcity
